notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability.
Repeat.
